description: The kind of a DocumentBlock. Determines which DocumentBlockContent subclass the block's Content carries, and how the Markdown, HTML, DOCX and Notion converters render it.

values.name: Heading
values.description: Heading of level 1-6. Content is HeadingBlockContent.

values.name: List
values.description: One list item, ordered or bulleted. A GFM task item sets ListBlockContent.IsChecked. Content is ListBlockContent.

values.name: Table
values.description: Table with per-column alignment. Content is TableBlockContent.

values.name: PageBreak
values.description: Page break. Exports as a Markdown thematic break (---) and maps to a Notion Divider.

values.name: ContentControl
values.description: Structured document tag (Word content control). Content is ContentControlBlockContent.

values.name: Code
values.description: Preformatted code. Its text is never parsed for inline markup. Content is CodeBlockContent.
